summary: Iteration 12 — frontend-only verification of the react-native -> react-native-tvOS fork swap + top tab-bar layout + bottom footer branding + new Pointer(mouse)-mode Settings toggle, on the web preview (https://iptv-player-guide.preview.emergentagent.com) at mobile viewport 390x844. RESULTS — ALL 8 REVIEW-REQUEST ITEMS PASS. (1) FORK BUNDLING/LAUNCH — Metro bundled 1524 modules successfully after the react-native -> react-native-tvos@0.81.5-1 swap (see /var/log/supervisor/expo.out.log 'Web Bundled 1041ms ... (1524 modules)'). No white screen: body text length = 27545 chars on first paint. No red screen, no bundling error, ErrorBoundary fallback never triggered. This was the #1 concern of the iteration and it is CLEAN. (2) TOP TAB BAR — Verified via DOM getBoundingClientRect: TV Guide (top=37, left=25), Favorites (top=37, left=121), Search (top=37, left=226), Settings (top=37, left=319). Viewport height=844, so tabs sit at ~4% from the top, i.e. the tab bar is at the TOP. Tapping each of the 4 tabs navigates correctly and the corresponding screen renders BELOW the tab bar (Favorites/Search/Settings content all start visible below top=~90). No 'bottom tabs' residue. (3) GUIDE HEADER ACTIONS AT TOP — guide-refresh-btn top=69, mode-timeline-btn top=72, mode-box-btn top=72, all directly under the tab bar. Group chips (chip-All / chip-Favorites / chip-Local / chip-Movies / chip-Sports / chip-TV) all visible on the chip row. (4) GUIDE FOOTER MOVED TO BOTTOM — 'Charm IPTV' text at top=820 and 'TV Guide' text at top=813 (of vh=844), i.e. inside the last ~30px of the screen. Re-verified after navigating away and back — footer coords unchanged (top=820/813). The old top-of-screen title block is gone. (5) GUIDE DATA — 36 windowed epg-channel-* testIDs visible (of 688 total in-memory), alphabetical (first item '5 StarMAX.HD.East'). Toggle to Box mode renders box-channel-* cards (verified: box-channel-5.StarMAX..., box-channel-AETV.us, box-channel-WABC.us). Group chips filter as expected. (6) PLAYER NAVIGATION — search-ch-ESPN.us (m3u4u) tap → /player opened successfully, player-back-btn visible, expected web fallback ('Unable to play this stream' / 'installed app build') shown, back returned to Guide. No crash across the open→back cycle. (7) SEARCH — search-input focus + keyboard.type('espn') returned 5 channel results (ESPN.us, ESPNHD.us, ESPNEWS.us, …). (8) SETTINGS — settings-refresh-btn visible, NEW settings-pointer-toggle visible + tappable (state flips on click), NO admin/login UI present. Stats correctly stream in via the iter-11 subscribeSource wiring: on tab open 'Channels loaded 0 / EPG 0 / Last refreshed —' initially, and after 5s auto-updates to 'Channels loaded 688 / Channels with EPG 662' WITHOUT pressing Refresh — confirming the iter-11 stale-stats fix is live and the pointer-mode Switch renders fine on the web with correct label 'Pointer (mouse) mode' and helper subtext explaining it is native-only. (9) CONSOLE — 0 uncaught JS errors across the full flow (Guide → Box → Favorites → Search → Player → Back → Settings → Guide). Whitelisted web-only warnings (useNativeDriver, pointerEvents deprecation, expo-notifications, storage QuotaExceededError) all ignored per test config. Deprecated packages detected: none new introduced this iteration. React Native issues: pointerEvents-prop deprecation still present in TimelineGrid.tsx:172 (carryover from prior iterations, cosmetic web-only warning). TV D-pad focus + pointer cursor overlay + video playback are native-only per the review-request note and were not exercised — code paths inspected for correctness (Platform.OS/Platform.isTV guards intact in player.tsx and _layout.tsx).

design_issues.screen: BoxGrid card (carryover from iter 10/11, NOT a regression of this iteration)
issues: Tapping the CENTER of a box-channel-* card opens the program-detail modal (Supergirl / Watch now) instead of navigating to /player, because a nested Pressable inside the card intercepts. Only the outer/logo area routes to /player. Verified reproducible from box grid this iteration. Ref: /app/frontend/src/components/BoxGrid.tsx nested Pressables. No functional impact on the TV-fork swap scope.

react_native_issues.issue: Cosmetic web-only warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Still present on the TimelineGrid now-line indicator. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/TimelineGrid.tsx:172. Carryover from iter 10/11, not a regression, whitelisted for testing.

action_items: NONE required for this iteration's scope — the react-native -> react-native-tvos fork swap did NOT regress web bundling/launch, top tab bar is correctly placed, and Charm IPTV / TV Guide footer is correctly at the bottom. Pointer-mode toggle renders and toggles cleanly. 0 console errors.

OPTIONAL (carryover): migrate pointerEvents='none' -> style={{pointerEvents:'none'}} on the now-line View in /app/frontend/src/components/TimelineGrid.tsx:172 to silence the RN-Web deprecation warning.
OPTIONAL (carryover from iter 10/11): reconsider whether tapping the CENTER of a BoxGrid card should navigate to /player instead of opening the program-detail modal. Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx: tabBarPosition:'top' correctly set (line 43), tab bar height adjusted for insets.top (60 + insets.top) — good handling of the safe-area on the top edge. Custom TabBarButton with focused ring is the right pattern for D-pad on Android TV (can only be verified on a native TV build).

app/(tabs)/index.tsx: The top title block was cleanly removed and replaced with a bottom footerTitles View (lines 152-155) using insets.bottom + spacing.sm padding. borderTopColor + backgroundColor:colors.surface keeps it visually anchored to the bottom of the screen even when the timeline/box lists are scrolling above. Footer renders as static (not inside the scroll container) so it stays fixed at the bottom of the Guide screen — exactly as requested.
app/(tabs)/favorites.tsx / search.tsx / settings.tsx: Correctly removed insets.top padding so the top tab bar handles the safe area — no double-padding, header spacing looks clean at 390x844.

app/(tabs)/settings.tsx: New Pointer (mouse) mode card with Switch bound to store.pointerMode and store.setPointerMode + descriptive subtext (lines 96-114). Persistence via the store (gs_pointer_mode) is code-verified. Iter-11 subscribeSource fix confirmed still present at line 32 — stats now stream in without manual refresh (0 -> 688/662 within ~5s of tab open).

player.tsx: Platform.isTV / canRotate guards from iter 11 are still intact (lines 43-44). ErrorBoundary around StreamPlayer at lines 137-144 remains. No regressions from the fork swap on the /player screen.

The @react-native-tvos/config-tv plugin + custom withTvRemote native plugin + StreamPlayer.web.tsx placeholder are all native-only per the spec and not exercisable on web — code paths inspected for correctness.

success_rate.frontend: 8/8 review-request items verified passing on the web preview. Native-only items (D-pad focus, pointer overlay cursor, video playback) intentionally not tested per the review-request note.

seed_data_creation: One favorite toggled during testing (5 Starmax) — persisted in-memory only on web (storage QuotaExceededError is swallowed by src/utils/storage.ts). No permanent data changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Base URL: https://iptv-player-guide.preview.emergentagent.com. Mobile viewport 390x844. Top-tab bar now at top=37 with labels TV Guide/Favorites/Search/Settings across left=25/121/226/319. Guide screen: guide-refresh-btn / mode-timeline-btn / mode-box-btn sit directly under the tab bar (~top=70). 'Charm IPTV' (top=820) + 'TV Guide' (top=813) are now a FOOTER at the bottom of the Guide screen — they now appear TWICE in the DOM per view: (a) at top=0/37 as the TAB LABEL of the TV Guide tab, and (b) at top=820/813 as the Guide screen's footer. If querying by exact text you'll get both — filter by y-coordinate. Settings stats reliably transition 0/0 → 688/662 within ~5s via subscribeSource without pressing refresh. NEW testID this iteration: settings-pointer-toggle (Switch). Native-only items (TV D-pad focus, pointer cursor overlay, video playback via react-native-tvos + custom withTvRemote plugin) MUST NOT be failed on web — they require an installed Android TV build. Same tooling notes as iter 11 still apply: (1) page.fill() on RN-Web TextInput does not fire onChangeText — use page.click then page.keyboard.type. (2) FlashList duplicates data-testid on internal buffers with a '#<n>' suffix — filter with 'if #not in tid'. (3) BoxGrid card center still opens program-detail modal instead of /player (nested Pressable, carryover from iter 10/11, not a regression).
rca_of_issue: No issues found this iteration. The fork swap (react-native -> npm:react-native-tvos@0.81.5-1 with resolutions + expo.install.exclude:[react-native]) did NOT regress the web bundle. The top-tab-bar (tabBarPosition:'top' in _layout.tsx) and the moved Charm IPTV / TV Guide footer at the bottom of Guide (footerTitles view in index.tsx with paddingBottom:insets.bottom+sm) are working exactly as described. Pointer mode toggle renders and toggles state cleanly via the store. Iter-11's Settings subscribeSource fix confirmed still working (0/0 → 688/662 in ~5s without manual refresh).
